analysis: post-result frozen-policy margin and paired-credit diagnosis

definitions.cohort: 48 states in 12 episodes and two seeds per split; training42/73 and exposed evaluation509/601
definitions.leave_one_out: eight descriptive seven-draw means; draws remain nested within each captured state
definitions.loss: mean across states of mean valid-action Huber error against associated conditioned H4 targets; shuffled arm is assessed against associated outcomes, not its acquisition donors
definitions.margin: score[action] - score[KEEP]; native choice is strict masked argmax with lowest-kind ties
definitions.scope: post-result description; all original choices, rewards and measurement rules retained

feature_support.definition: Coordinate min/max coverage of the captured 29-feature vectors; a descriptive box, not a learned support model.
